basic_details.job_title: Gauhati High Court Group D (MTS) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Gauhati High Court (Gauhati High Court Recruitment 2026) has 2 unreserved Group-D (MTS) posts at its Aizawl Bench in Pay level-1 (17,400 – 38,600). The minimum qualification is Class-VIII, and anyone who has passed HSSLC (Class-XII) or above cannot apply. Applications are accepted online only, through ghconline.gov.in or ghcazlbench.nic.in. The application window opens on 3 November 2026 at 3:00 PM and closes on 17 November 2026, at the end of office working hours.

For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

how_to_apply: You need a valid e-mail ID and mobile number to register. Keep the e-mail ID active. The system is meant to send an e-mail with the Registration Code, but the notice says this e-mail may not arrive because of network congestion. Write down your Registration Code yourself.
Go to https://ghconline.gov.in or https://ghcazlbench.nic.in/ between 3 November 2026 (from 3:00 PM) and 17 November 2026 (till office working hours).
Click on "Online application for the post of Group-D (MTS) in the Aizawl Bench of the Gauhati High Court".
Register with your e-mail ID and mobile number, and note down the Registration Code.
Fill in the form with your photograph and signature. An incomplete form is liable to be rejected summarily, unless the High Court decides otherwise.
Upload clear scanned copies of the documents listed below.
Pay the application fee by 20 November 2026, within bank transaction hours.
Once you submit the application, you cannot change it. Applications sent in any other way will be rejected summarily, without any communication.
Age proof (Birth certificate / Class X admit card)
No Objection Certificate from the present employer (only for Government employees)
At later stages, when asked, candidates must show the originals of their certificates for educational qualification, reservation claim, date of birth, caste and work experience (if applicable).
The fee is not refunded under any circumstances. It is also not kept in reserve for any other examination or selection process.

For technical help with the online form, e-mail [email protected]. Put the name of the post in the subject line. In the body, give your Registration Code (if any), your name, your father's name and the problem. Send a copy of the e-mail to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from citizens of India as defined under Article 5 and 6 of the Constitution of India. In the application form, candidates must declare that they have the minimum qualification of Class VIII standard and have not passed HSSLC (12th) or above. A candidate who hides their highest educational qualification will have the candidature rejected and may also face other legal action. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification. Age is counted as on the last date for receiving online applications. For PwBD candidates, the upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years. A person is not eligible for appointment if they have married someone who has a living spouse. The same applies to a person who has married again while their own spouse is living. A reservation claim must be backed by a certificate issued by the competent authority. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: a written examination (Stage-I, 70 marks) and then an interview/viva-voce with document verification (Stage-II, 20 marks). The written examination has objective multiple-choice questions, answered on an OMR sheet. It lasts 1½ hours (90 minutes). The Mizo language part is qualifying only. To pass the written examination, a candidate must score at least 40% in it, i.e. 8 out of 20 marks. Marks from the Mizo part are not counted when the merit list is prepared. Candidates are called for the interview/viva-voce and document verification on the basis of their written-examination merit, in the ratio of 1:3 (3 candidates for each post). To qualify, a candidate must score at least 60% in the interview, i.e. 12 out of 20 marks. Final selection is based on the total marks from the written examination and the interview/viva-voce. If two or more candidates have the same total, the one with more written-examination marks is preferred. If those marks are also equal, the older candidate is preferred. The High Court reserves the right to fix or change the cut-off marks for the written examination and the viva-voce. Selected candidates may be assigned any Group-D position(s) based on administrative convenience.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Gauhati High Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 Group-D (MTS) vacancies, both Unreserved, at the Aizawl Bench of the Gauhati High Court. The number of posts may change at the time of final selection.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Gauhati High Court Group-D (MTS)?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 17 November 2026, till office working hours. The fee can be paid until 20 November 2026, within bank transaction hours.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Gauhati High Court Group-D (MTS)?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class-VIII (8th) standard. Anyone who has passed HSSLC (Class-XII) or above is ineligible, and hiding your highest qualification leads to rejection.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Gauhati High Court Group-D (MTS)?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years for Unreserved candidates and 18 to 40 years for SC/ST candidates, counted as on the last date of online application. PwBD candidates get 10 years of relaxation in the upper age limit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Gauhati High Court Group-D (MTS)?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay level-1 (17,400 – 38,600).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is 500/- for Unreserved candidates and 250/- for SC/ST candidates. PwBD candidates pay nothing (Nil). The fee is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for Gauhati High Court Group-D (MTS)?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://ghconline.gov.in or https://ghcazlbench.nic.in/ by clicking "Online application for the post of Group-D (MTS) in the Aizawl Bench of the Gauhati High Court". Register with a valid e-mail ID and mobile number, and upload the required documents. Applications in any other mode are rejected.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: There is a 70-mark written examination (90 minutes, OMR), followed by a 20-mark interview/viva-voce with document verification. Candidates are called for the interview in the ratio of 1:3. Final selection is based on total marks.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Mizo language test compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. Part 2 of the written examination tests Mizo language proficiency for 20 marks, and candidates must score at least 8 of those 20 marks (40%) to qualify. These marks are not counted in the merit list.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the written test or the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the written test or the interview.
